about: Shared data for the study site. exams: date is YYYY-MM-DD and time is HH:MM, both in Japan time; leave them null until announced. page is the exam's notes page, once it has one. news: newest first, each with a short title (the home page shows it, and the text when tapped); entries from the last 14 days get a New label.

news.subject: math
news.title: Calculus midterm 2: shortcuts for integrals
news.text: Calculus midterm 2: two lessons now end with a Shortcuts box of extra tricks that aren't from the lectures. Day 16 & 17: rebuilding the arcsin and arctan values from the special triangles, odd functions on [−a, a], and half-circle areas. Day 18 & 19: guess and adjust, making the derivative appear on top, the cover-up method for partial fractions, which factor to differentiate in integration by parts, the DI table, and the King's rule. Formulas has a Shortcuts group, and Practice has three new problems to try them on.

news.subject: math
news.title: Calculus midterm 2: substitution, integration by parts and Quiz 07
news.text: Calculus midterm 2: Day 18 & 19 are added: integration by substitution (with the limits moved to the u-axis), rational forms (partial fractions, or a square and arctan when the denominator doesn't factor), √(ax + b) and u = tan(x/2), then integration by parts. Practice has the class examples and both exercise sets with step-by-step solutions, plus a "Which method?" drill; Formulas has two new groups. Quizzes has In-class Quiz 07 (password needed) with Follow-up A and B, and the primitive-functions lesson now includes the inverse trigonometric functions from 9 Nov.

news.subject: all
news.title: Easier to use: a today screen, practice sessions and night-before sheets
news.text: The home page opens with the next exam: its countdown, how far Practice has got, and a link back to where you left off. Practice has sessions that show one problem at a time, picked by lesson or chapter (and level, in Physics). Each exam page has a night-before sheet with the formulas, the common mistakes and the exam-day habits on one page, ready to print. Headers are slimmer on phones, the calculator button rests as a slim tab on the screen edge, and search results show formulas as they're written.

news.subject: math
news.title: Calculus midterm 2: primitive functions and Quiz 06
news.text: Calculus midterm 2: primitive functions (Day 16 & 17) are added: primitives and the +C, the indefinite integral, F(b) − F(a), the fundamental primitive functions (powers, 1/x, eˣ and bˣ, sin and cos, arctan) and what to watch out for, with nine practice problems and two formula groups. Quizzes has In-class Quiz 06 (password needed) with Follow-up A and B. The Riemann-sum lesson is shorter now, down to what the quizzes ask.

news.subject: math
news.title: Calculus midterm 2: the second class on Riemann sums
news.text: Calculus midterm 2: the second class on Riemann sums and definite integrals is added. The class example x² + x − 2 shows how the integral and the area differ, then integrals on any interval [a, b], the properties of the definite integral, and why some functions such as sin x / x have no antiderivative formula. Four new practice problems and a second formula group.

news.subject: physics
news.title: Physics midterm: Practice and three mock midterms
news.text: Physics midterm: Practice and Exams are ready. Practice has 103 problems, chapter by chapter, in three tiers: Foundation, Application, and Advanced in the style of the exercise days. Exams has three mock midterms in the exam’s format, six problems in 60 minutes, with a timer, worked answers and self-marking.

news.subject: math
news.title: Calculus midterm 2 has its own page
news.text: Calculus midterm 2 (integrals) has its own page, starting with Riemann sums and definite integrals: the key ideas with an interactive graph, eight practice problems with step-by-step solutions, and the formulas. Its Summary lists every lesson up to the midterm on 23 Nov.

news.subject: physics
news.title: Physics midterm: Summary and Formulas
news.text: Physics midterm: Summary and Formulas are ready. The summary goes module by module through Chapters 1–8: the key ideas, one worked example for each module, and what to watch out for. Formulas has every formula of the eight chapters, marked by importance, with helpful results the book doesn’t print, the special angles, and Test me.

news.subject: physics
news.title: Physics is here, starting with the midterm
news.text: Physics is here: a page for the midterm (Chapters 1–8). Quizzes has the two exercise-day sheets from class, retyped with worked answers and opened with the in-class password, and three new practice sets in the same format. Summaries, practice problems and formulas follow.

news.subject: math
news.title: Math: a page for each exam
news.text: Math now has a page for each exam, so each one loads faster. Calculus midterm 1 (derivatives) is ready; midterm 2 (integrals) and the Linear Algebra midterm get theirs once their classes start.

news.subject: math
news.title: Past midterms: this year's Calculus midterm 1
news.text: Exams: the AY2026 Calculus midterm 1 (derivative part), retyped with worked answers, joins the past midterms. It opens with the in-class password.

news.subject: all
news.title: A cleaner look, a side menu and printing
news.text: A cleaner look: one button style, full-size formulas, exam questions laid out like a paper, and a side menu on computers and iPads. Mocks and past midterms can be printed, with or without answers.

news.subject: math
news.title: Past midterms from AY2022 and AY2023
news.text: Exams: two past midterms (AY2022 and AY2023) with worked answers, a timer and self-scoring. They open with the in-class password.

news.subject: math
news.title: Summary follows the course schedule
news.text: Summary: each section now follows the course schedule, with its day numbers, dates and lesson name. Infinite series (Day 9) has a section of its own.

news.title: Day 12: differential equations
news.text: Day 12: an introduction to differential equations, with two interactive graphs, practice problems and formulas. It isn't on the midterm.

news.text: Exams: Calculus midterm 2 (integrals) on 23 Nov now has a countdown.

news.text: Exams tab: three mock midterms with a countdown timer and self-scoring, plus upcoming exams.
